title: LengthLimitError typed downcast replaces string-match heuristic
description: peer_fetch.rs replaces the e.to_string().contains("length limit") heuristic with e.downcast_ref::<LengthLimitError>().is_some(). This is strictly better and should be defended against suggestions to revert to string matching for 'simplicity'. The string match was fragile because http-body-util does not guarantee the error message text across semver-minor versions. The downcast is stable because LengthLimitError is a public type (http-body-util 0.1 API). The comment explaining the old heuristic is correctly removed.
